description: This file defines the DeprecationCollector class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for collecting deprecated features or usages within templates by scanning directories or individual templates.

classes.name: DeprecationCollector
classes.description: A class for collecting deprecation notices from Twig templates by scanning directories or individual templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DeprecationCollector with a Twig Environment instance.

methods.name: collectDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for Twig templates with specified extension and collects deprecation notices from them.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Processes an iterator of templates, tokenizes each, parses them, and collects deprecation messages from user-level deprecation errors.
